entities.summary: Frederick Gayle Hilton is an American former professional basketball shooting guard who played two seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Buffalo Braves (1971–73). He attended Grambling State University where he was drafted in the second round of the 1971 NBA draft by the Braves.
